lead.summary: The final rule updates maintenance inspection requirements for single-engine turbine-powered airplanes and unmanned aircraft, providing owners and operators with more inspection program options and relaxed mechanical reliability reporting requirements.

leads.title: Spain holds state funeral for 69 killed in high-speed rail crash
leads.summary: Relatives of the 69 people killed in a high-speed rail collision in Spain last month attended a state funeral on Tuesday with Spain’s royals, almost two weeks after the crash.

leads.title: Amazon makes aviation history with world’s first SAIL 4 drone approval
leads.summary: Amazon Prime Air received the world’s first SAIL 4 Operating Authorisation from the UK Civil Aviation Authority on 10 November, allowing drone deliveries to expand from approximately 600 to around 8,000 households in Darlington. The approval permits beyond-visual-line-of-sight flights in more densely populated areas, delivering eligible products weighing 5 lbs or less in under two hours.

stories.title: United States: Secretary Mullin Joins White House Task Force at Drone Security Forum to Protect the Homeland From Unauthorized Drone Threats
stories.summary: DHS Secretary Markwayne Mullin attended the Second Annual Countering the Threat: Drone Security Industry and SLTT Grant Forum at MGM National Harbor in Maryland, where leaders discussed counter-unmanned aircraft systems priorities and planning for the 2028 Summer Olympics. The event highlighted the Counter-UAS Grant Program, which provides $500 million over two fiscal years to help communities build drone-security capabilities, with the first $250 million awarded in Fiscal Year 2026 to 11 states and the National Capital Region.

also.title: KEEPING THE SKIES SAFE: White House Olympics Task Force, DRONERESPONDERS & Commercial Drone Alliance Host

stories.title: Tesla Edges Past Waymo in Texas Self-Driving Vehicle Registrations
stories.summary: Tesla now lists 1,302 vehicles in Texas’s automated-vehicle registry, five more than Waymo. The totals do not measure cars actively carrying riders.

stories.title: IATA Warns of New Aviation Security Risks as Drones, Cyberattacks and Bomb Hoaxes Disrupt European Travel -
stories.summary: Nick Careen, IATA’s Senior Vice President, Operations, Safety and Security, called for real-time intelligence sharing and closer coordination between airlines, airports, governments, military authorities, and law enforcement agencies at the Global Tourism Forum Annual Meeting 2026 in Brussels on November 10. He cited more than 25 recent hoax bomb threats and over 200 drone incursions in NATO airspace between January 2025 and October 2026 as evidence of new vulnerabilities requiring integrated responses.

stories.title: Connected Autonomous Vehicles Boost Network Resilience but Recovery
stories.summary: Researchers published a scoping review in the European Transport Research Review analyzing 106 studies on connected autonomous vehicle network resilience. The review found that research heavily emphasizes robustness and resourcefulness, while rapidity remains the least explored attribute, appearing in only 31 papers.

stories.title: Hegseth issues ‘corrected copy’ of recently unveiled counter-drone guidance
stories.summary: Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth issued a corrected memorandum dated Nov. 5 that removes references to a Deputy General Counsel for DRPM Programs and redirects legal reviews to the Office of the General Counsel through Joint Interagency Task Force 401’s legal advisor. The update modifies late September directives aimed at reforming approval processes for counter-drone capabilities.

stories.title: Australia urgently needs an air taxi research and development sandbox
stories.summary: Clem Newton-Brown of Skyportz warned at Global Drone 2026 that Australia risks falling behind.

stories.title: AutoPylot Maps Nearly 2,000 Local Drone Rules That LAANC Doesn't Cover
stories.summary: AutoPylot opened its Pilot Reports feature to all pilots in 50 states on November 9, adding nearly 2,000 local drone rules to its flight map. The company reviews submissions, usually within 48 hours, before displaying them to other users.

stories.title: AUVSI Hands CEO Job To Counter-Drone Executive Brett Feddersen
stories.summary: The Association for Uncrewed Vehicle Systems International (AUVSI) named Brett Feddersen its president and CEO, effective December 1. Feddersen replaces Michael Robbins, who left for the Semiconductor Industry Association at the end of September, and moves into the role from a seat on AUVSI’s board.

stories.title: Funding Drone Innovation for the Last Tactical Mile
stories.summary: The Department of Defense committed more than $115 million to Unmanned Ground Vehicle projects in FY26 and launched Project Agincourt in late September 2026 to accelerate the development and deployment of autonomous military systems.

stories.title: Strathcona, CN Railway plan crude-by-rail link
stories.summary: Strathcona Resources and Canadian National Railway plan a C$2.5 billion to C$3.5 billion crude-by-rail link to Prince Rupert, British Columbia. Northern Express would transport 250,000 barrels daily and could diversify Canadian oil exports before the proposed Pacific Link pipeline begins operating.

stories.title: AllAI equips legacy industrial robots with AI control for autonomous work
stories.summary: AllAI equips existing industrial robots with an artificial intelligence (AI) control system to enable autonomous operation in changing work environments. The company has shipped over 1,500 control boards, secured purchase orders worth about 2 billion won, and is targeting 1.9 billion to 2 billion won in revenue this year.

stories.title: Tesla Private FSD Claim: $99 Plan, 0 Confirmed [2026]
stories.summary: A Forbes analysis syndicated on Yahoo Autos suggests Tesla private FSD may reach customers only through the Robotaxi fleet, citing a potential legal flaw. Tesla has not confirmed this claim, and the report notes that Full Self-Driving (Supervised) remains a $99 per month subscription where the driver stays responsible for traffic violations.

stories.title: Allen Control Systems launches new division to develop counter-drone lasers
stories.summary: Allen Control Systems announced the launch of a new directed energy division to provide high-energy lasers to U.S. and allied militaries for countering adversarial drones. The division will be led by Amanda Clark and John Mason, former leaders at the Army’s Space and Missile Defense Command.

also.title: ACS opens laser division amid counter-drone boom

stories.title: Ukrainian Drone Strikes May Cut Russian Oil Refining Capacity by 30%
stories.summary: Ukrainian drone strikes disrupted operations at nine of Russia’s 35 largest refineries, with a combined daily capacity of about 300,000 tonnes. Industry officials estimate the attacks may have cut Russia’s refining capacity by around 30%.

stories.title: Remote mine hunters silently trawl the waters as minesweepers go by the wayside
EU-Ukraine drone alliance ramps up efforts to counter evolving battlefield threats
stories.summary: The European Commission held the second board meeting of the EU-Ukraine Drone Alliance in Brussels, where 18 founding members adopted terms of reference. Working groups are expected to begin activities in the coming months, and the board’s third meeting is scheduled for early 2027.

stories.title: Initial buzz fades, hydrogen train witnesses routine footfall
stories.summary: The hydrogen train operating between Jind and Sonepat has seen initial excitement subside, with passenger numbers now comparable to other trains on the route. A railway official stated that 50 to 60 tickets were issued at Jind station when the train began its journey, while subsequent stations recorded good footfall.

stories.title: AI saved air cargo? Rates up 30% YOY
stories.summary: Air cargo rates rose 30% year over year and volumes grew 6% due to AI equipment demand, while Walmart deploys Wing and Zipline drones across nearly 300 stores. Zipline raised $1.5 billion and Wing will invest $125 million in a Texas factory ahead of new FAA rules for beyond-line-of-sight flights.

stories.title: GE Aerospace and BETA Technologies Celebrate World-First Milestone for Commercial Hybrid Electric Propulsion
stories.summary: GE Aerospace and BETA Technologies completed the world’s first hybrid-electric-assisted takeoff using a modified Saab 340B at BETA’s flight test facility in Plattsburgh, New York. The test utilized a GE Aerospace CT7 gas engine and a modified hybrid electric engine, with early observations indicating less noise compared to gas engines alone.

also.title: GE Aerospace and BETA Complete Hybrid-Electric Assisted Takeoff Test

stories.title: Washington state port, short line win FRA grant to modernize 19 crossings
stories.summary: The Federal Railroad Administration awarded the Port of Pend Oreille an $8.92 million grant to modernize 19 grade crossings in northeastern Washington and northern Idaho. The port will provide a required $2.23 million nonfederal match for the $11.15 million project, which includes upgraded warning systems and signal circuitry. Port Executive Director Kelly Driver estimates the work will take around five years to complete.

stories.title: Rising Q3 transportation costs squeeze manufacturers, reward railroads and reshape trade
stories.summary: Ford Chief Executive Jim Farley said the company currently expects commodities, memory and logistics costs to represent a year-over-year headwind of about $2 billion. Union Pacific Chief Executive Jim Vena noted that higher fuel prices are naturally an advantage for railroads because they are much more efficient than trucking.

stories.title: Spain holds state funeral for 69 killed in high-speed rail crash
stories.summary: Relatives of the 69 people killed in a high-speed rail collision in Spain last month attended a state funeral on Tuesday with Spain’s royals, almost two weeks after the crash.

stories.title: Ukraine Upgrades Pluton System to Detect Mesh Modems in Russian Drones
stories.summary: Ukrainian defense technology company Infozahyst announced an upgrade to its Pluton drone detection system to identify mesh modems used to control Russian unmanned aerial vehicles. The update allows the system to monitor 1.5 and 3.4 GHz frequencies over a range of up to 70 kilometers, enabling remote monitoring of multiple units simultaneously.

stories.title: State attorney’s office sends subpoena to JTA, asks for records involving top execs, autonomous vehicle program
stories.summary: The 4th Circuit State Attorney’s Office sent a subpoena to the Jacksonville Transportation Authority for records from Oct. 1, 2023, through the present, including communications regarding budget shortfalls and procurement records for specific vendors. The subpoena directs JTA to produce the records by Nov. 20.

stories.title: Austin's light rail system takes first step toward 3-mile airport connection
stories.summary: The Austin Transit Partnership announced Nov. 10 that it is beginning planning for a roughly 3-mile light rail extension to Austin-Bergstrom International Airport. The project, described as a mostly elevated structure, will involve a new National Environmental Policy Act review with the Federal Transit Administration and coordination with the airport's Journey With AUS expansion program.

also.title: Austin Transit Partnership begins planning light rail extension to city airport

stories.title: Dynamic Creatures partners with Sixth Wall Studio to bring Hasbro characters to life with robots
stories.summary: Dynamic Creatures announced a partnership with Sixth Wall Studio, an AI studio launched by Hasbro in June 2026, to create interactive robots that bring Hasbro characters to life. The collaboration combines Dynamic Creatures' mobile robots with Sixth Wall's CharacterOS platform to enable personalized, memory-enabled interactions at theme parks, resorts, and other venues.

stories.title: UPS and Pickle Robot: Has Robotic Truck Unloading Finally Reached Its Scale-Up Moment?
stories.summary: UPS plans to invest approximately $120 million to purchase 400 truck-unloading robots from Pickle Robot, with deployments expected at multiple facilities beginning in the second half of 2026 and continuing into 2027. The systems can handle boxes weighing up to approximately 50 pounds and unload a typical trailer in around two hours.

stories.title: UK plans wider naval drone effort after 41% rise in Russian activity
stories.summary: The Royal Navy plans to expand a 10-country maritime defence effort, with drones able to operate alongside allied warships, in response to a 41% increase in Russian naval activity around the UK in the first nine months of 2026. The initiative includes £1.5bn for sea drones over four years and an additional £90m for underwater drones and sensors to monitor Russian submarine activity in the Greenland-Iceland-UK gap.

stories.title: ACSL and Unmanned Safety Institute Partner on SOTEN Drone Training and Certification
stories.summary: ACSL and Unmanned Safety Institute (USI) announced a partnership on Tuesday to build a training curriculum and certification program for the SOTEN drone platform. Courses are expected to become available at the end of November or in early December, offering multiple levels from introductory overviews to advanced operations.

stories.title: Kingston students gain access to revolutionary £450k robot to boost engineering careers
stories.summary: Kingston University installed a £450,000 Zeus Robotic Cell from Rapid Fusion to teach students additive manufacturing and CNC milling. Rapid Fusion will also provide work placements and curriculum input to address a UK skills gap in robotics and 3D printing.

stories.title: Tesla backs NHTSA plan to modernize headlight rules for camera-based lighting
stories.summary: Tesla submitted a letter on Monday supporting the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration’s plan to modernize Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard No. 108, arguing current rules fail to accommodate camera-based adaptive lighting. The automaker also requested more individual manufacturer representatives on the proposed 18-member advisory committee, which NHTSA announced on October 8, 2026.

stories.title: China blocks SoftBank’s $5.4 billion takeover of ABB Robotics
stories.summary: China blocked SoftBank Group’s proposed $5.4 billion acquisition of ABB’s robotics business, a decision confirmed by ABB on November 5. ABB stated that both sides remained in discussions and were working constructively on the proposed sale.

also.title: Softbank and ABB reenter talks after China blocked acquisition

stories.title: Could netting protect F-35s from drones? US Air Force explores new defences
stories.summary: The US Air Force issued a request for information to install counter-unmanned aircraft system netting on six aircraft sunshade structures at Tyndall Air Force Base in Florida. The 325th Contracting Squadron seeks to protect parked F-35A fighter jets from Group 1 small drones, with each structure measuring 630 feet long, 65 feet wide, and 30 feet high.

also.title: Netting To Shield F-35s At Tyndall AFB From Drone Attacks Eyed By USAF
US Air Force seeks contractors to protect F-35s from drones with nets — The War Zone

stories.title: Ukraine's fiber-optic drone makers face six- to tenfold fiber price rises as AI data centers compete for supply
stories.summary: Ukrainian fiber-optic drone makers are paying roughly six to 10 times more for optical fiber than in 2025, according to a BlueBird Tech representative. TrendForce forecasts a 2026 global fiber shortfall of 180 million fiber-kilometers, with data centers accounting for 18%-20% of 2026 global fiber demand.

stories.title: ASI and RDO Equipment Co. Share Successful Autonomous Fleet Deployment Lessons at AEMP EQShift 2026
stories.summary: Autonomous Solutions, Inc. and RDO Equipment Co. will present lessons from autonomous fleet deployments at AEMP EQShift 2026 in New Orleans on November 18, 2026. The session focuses on site readiness, organizational preparation, and ecosystem integration for industrial vehicle automation.

stories.title: Allen Makes the Case for Driverless Cars on District Terms
stories.summary: Charles Allen estimated that if the legislation becomes law and is funded, autonomous vehicles could appear on the road as early as October 2027, though he said early 2028 is more likely.

also.title: Revised DC bill would clear path for driverless taxis, but does it have the votes?
D.C. Council Might Pump the Brakes on Legalizing Autonomous Vehicles

stories.title: Nidus Raises $30 Million to Expand AI-Powered Robotics in U.S. Defense Manufacturing
stories.summary: Nidus raised $30 million from Kleiner Perkins, Costanoa, Ludlow Ventures, SF1, Absolute Partners, and Tau to expand AI-powered robotic systems across U.S. defense factories. The company will use the funding to grow its engineering team, develop new automation capabilities, and increase deployments with U.S. defense manufacturers.

also.title: Pentagon Commits Up to $450 Million to Expand U.S. Drone Manufacturing

stories.title: Inspection Programs for Single-Engine Turbine-Powered Airplanes and Unmanned Aircraft; and Miscellaneous Maintenance-Related Updates
stories.summary: The final rule updates maintenance inspection requirements for single-engine turbine-powered airplanes and unmanned aircraft, providing owners and operators with more inspection program options and relaxed mechanical reliability reporting requirements.

stories.title: Notice of Petition for Extension of Waiver of Compliance
stories.summary: Denton County Transit Authority (DCTA) petitioned FRA for an extension of relief from certain regulations related to passenger equipment.

stories.title: AirMatrix Awarded Second Federal Contract to Expand Sovereign Counter-UAS and Low-Altitude Airspace Capabilities
stories.summary: AirMatrix Inc. began deploying its Libra command-and-control platform under a second contract with Innovative Solutions Canada, supporting the Department of National Defence. The system integrates radar, optical, and acoustic sensors to provide a unified operational air picture for low-altitude airspace.

stories.title: Ukrainian drone forces post video of strike on Russian drone base in Donetsk – video
stories.summary: The 412th Separate Unmanned Systems Brigade, known as Nemesis, released footage of a strike by its drone operators on a Russian drone base at Donetsk airport using Middle Strike (mid-range) UAVs. The brigade did not specify when the operation took place, but Ukrainska Pravda has learned that it was this autumn.

stories.title: Rail News - Caltrain secures over $100M for grade separations. For Railroad Career Professionals
stories.summary: Caltrain and partners secured over $100 million in Federal Railroad Administration grants for two grade-separation projects. The FRA awarded $90 million for the Broadway project in Burlingame, with construction starting in May 2027 and finishing in January 2032. Sunnyvale received up to $15.5 million for final design of the Mary Avenue project.

stories.title: Why predictive maintenance matters more as factories add robots
Commercial air taxi flights planned for these 5 US regions
stories.summary: Archer Aviation, Beta Technologies and Joby Aviation are preparing for passenger operations with test flights in New York City, Los Angeles, the San Francisco Bay Area, Florida and Texas. The companies are moving closer to FAA type certification and commercial operations as they begin passenger flights under the market survey certificate and conduct piloted flights in cities and states across the country.

stories.title: Royal Navy plans to launch Talon jet drone from carrier in 2027
stories.summary: The First Sea Lord announced plans to launch Northrop Grumman’s Talon uncrewed jet from a Royal Navy aircraft carrier in UK waters in 2027. General Sir Gwyn Jenkins will sign a statement of intent with Northrop Grumman on 12 November to prepare for trials under RN Project VANQUISH.

also.title: Britain to trial Talon drone from aircraft carrier

stories.title: Kearney, MIT put US driverless truck cost parity at 2028
stories.summary: Kearney and the MIT Mobility Initiative project that autonomous trucks will match the per-mile cost of trucks with drivers in the US around 2028, according to a report released Nov. 5. Their model puts a driverless truck at $4 a mile in 2026, against $2.50 for a conventional truck, with the two crossing at roughly $2.60 in 2028.

stories.title: Thales joins forces with Kongsberg Maritime to support the Royal Navy’s future Type 92 anti-submarine Uncrewed Surface Vessel
Martinus Group to build Port of Moses Lake rail link
stories.summary: The Port of Moses Lake appointed Martinus Rail as principal contractor for the first phase of the Northern Columbia Basin Railroad Project in Washington State. The $31.75m contract covers 7.6 km of new railway and upgrades to 4.3 km of existing track, with completion planned for spring 2028.

stories.title: Oversonic Robotics takes RoBee R20 humanoid robot to Munich and Lisbon
stories.summary: Oversonic Robotics will showcase its RoBee R20 humanoid robot at electronica in Munich and Web Summit in Lisbon. The Italian company, which began deploying cognitive robots in industrial production in 2023, aims to expand its international presence following its appearance at CES 2026 in Las Vegas.

stories.title: Ukrainian forces rescue wounded soldier using bomber drone, electric unicycle and ground robot
stories.summary: Soldiers from Ukraine's 14th National Guard Brigade rescued a wounded soldier on the Dobropillia front using a heavy bomber drone, an electric unicycle and an unmanned ground vehicle. The operation took place in autumn 2026 and involved delivering more than a litre of blood via drone before evacuating the soldier 14 km on the UGV.

stories.title: ASICS warehouse drones quickly find misplaced inventory
stories.summary: ASICS began using Corvus Robotics drones to count inventory at its Byhalia, Mississippi, distribution center, recovering misplaced products nearly 60% faster and saving 200 hours of monthly labor. The system allows ASICS to ship orders on time and at full price by analyzing nightly data monthly.

also.title: ASICS cuts inventory recovery time 60 percent using Corvus Robotics drones

stories.title: Kodiak to add International tractors to autonomous options
stories.summary: Kodiak unveiled plans Nov. 5 to add International’s LT tractor to its autonomous fleet options, with retrofitted tractors from International Motors, Peterbilt, and Western Star available in the second half of 2027. The company stated its software and hardware are 99% ready for unsupervised longhaul routes, which it plans to launch by the end of 2026 on Interstate 45 between Dallas and Houston.

stories.title: Chile is strengthening drone oversight – can enforcement keep pace?
stories.summary: Chile's Dirección General de Aeronáutica Civil (DGAC) awarded UAV LATAM Chile SpA a CLP 19.29 million contract in July 2025 for two portable drone detection systems. The DGAC and the Policía de Investigaciones de Chile (PDI) conducted a joint inspection exercise at Eulogio Sánchez aerodrome in August 2026, with further inspections planned for the second half of 2026.

stories.title: Path Robotics Raises $300M Series E at $2.45B to Expand Manufacturing AI
stories.summary: Path Robotics raised $300 million in Series E financing at a $2.45 billion post-money valuation, led by Georgian, to expand its physical AI beyond welding into more manufacturing tasks and robotic form factors. The Columbus, Ohio-based company plans to use the capital to deploy its platform in industries critical to U.S. industrial capacity, including shipbuilding and defense, while increasing investment in AI model training.

also.title: Path Robotics raises $300M at $2.45B valuation to scale physical AI for manufacturing
Path Robotics raises stunning $300 million at $2.45 billion valuation to expand physical AI in manufacturing
Path Robotics: $300 Million Series E At $2.45 Billion Valuation Funds Manufacturing AI Expansion

stories.title: Czech government approves new counter-drone legislation
stories.summary: The Czech government approved draft legislation on 9 November that allows critical infrastructure entities and police to intervene against drones illegally entering no-fly zones. The new laws enable the Civil Aviation Authority to introduce a new type of zone for critical infrastructure protection and strengthen police counter-drone authorities beyond critical infrastructure sites.

stories.title: Why There’s Still No One-Size-Fits-All Solution for Drone Collision Avoidance
stories.summary: FAA, NASA, and uAvionix representatives discussed detect-and-avoid technology challenges at the AUVSI Drone and AAM Policy Symposium in Washington, DC, noting that no single sensor solution exists for beyond visual line of sight operations. FAA Manager Marcus Cunningham stated the agency has never been closer to completing the proposed Part 108 rule, which aims to establish a regulatory framework for routine beyond visual line of sight flight.

stories.title: Paying more, getting less: six years of CAA drone charges
stories.summary: The Civil Aviation Authority proposed a 6.1% increase in drone operator charges from 1 April 2027, raising the operator ID fee to approximately £13.09 and the PDRA01 operational authorisation to about £556. The consultation closes at midnight on 21 December.

stories.title: Witherite Law Group Founder Amy Witherite Calls for Federal Driverless Taxi Safety Standards
stories.summary: Amy Witherite, founder of Witherite Law Group, is calling for federal standards requiring driverless taxi operators to show they can quickly clear vehicles from the path of first responders before putting them on public roads.

stories.title: Top Key Players Agility Robotics, Figure, Warehouse Humanoid Robots Market to Reach USD 6,203.6 Million by 203
stories.summary: Future Market Insights projects the global Warehouse Humanoid Robots Market will grow from USD 450.0 million in 2026 to USD 6,203.6 million by 2036, registering a compound annual growth rate of 30.0%.

stories.title: Wing and Walmart Launch Drone Delivery in Memphis
stories.summary: Wing launched drone delivery with Walmart in Memphis, its first Tennessee market, serving tens of thousands of homes near three Supercenters in Bartlett, Cordova, and West Memphis. Orders arrive in as little as 30 minutes, with drones carrying up to 2.75 pounds per trip. The companies plan to reach nearly 20 major U.S. metros by 2027.

stories.title: ANRA, Wing, Manna and Lancashire Fire Demonstrate Shared Airspace Operations in UK
stories.summary: ANRA Technologies, Wing, Manna Air Delivery, and Lancashire Fire and Rescue Service demonstrated shared airspace operations in Chorley, Lancashire, using different traffic management systems. The UK Civil Aviation Authority approved the digital coordination approach, which combined commercial delivery and emergency service flights within a single Temporary Danger Area.

also.title: U.K. shared airspace project advances coordinated drone operations in Chorley
UK Drone Airspace Integration Project Advances Coordinated UAS Flights in Chorley
UK advances shared airspace for commercial drone operations
UK Demonstration Tests Shared Drone Flight Airspace in Chorley

stories.title: T4 Robotics Appoints Paul Hughes Co-CEO, Expands Into Unmanned Maritime Defense Systems
stories.summary: T4 Robotics appointed Paul Hughes as Co-Chief Executive Officer and announced plans to develop unmanned surface vehicles for anti-naval applications in the United States, Ukraine, and NATO-aligned countries. The company’s first concept, Toe-biter, is in the development stage with no production timeline announced.

stories.title: Royal Navy says £90 million drone and sensor network will hunt Russian submarines and guard undersea cables
stories.summary: The Royal Navy announced a framework with Ocean Infinity Solutions to invest £90 million in Atlantic Net, an underwater drone and sensor network designed to detect Russian submarines and protect North Atlantic cables. The Navy said the agreement would support almost 200 new skilled jobs and was due to be signed at the International Sea Power Conference in Oslo.

also.title: UK invests £90m in autonomous tech to counter Russian undersea threats

stories.title: AirSight Provides Software to See, Track, Identify Drones
stories.summary: On November 4, Dallas-based AirSight announced the release of an add-on to its AirGuard drone detection software platform that allows users to identify repeat offenders and risky flight patterns at a glance and share their findings with security personnel within minutes. The company works with 30-plus vendors that manufacture radars and radio-frequency sensors, integrating and fusing the data to make sense of it.

stories.title: Ericsson brings drone detection capabilities to mobile networks
stories.summary: Ericsson introduced the Ericsson ISAC System, which adds drone detection capabilities to existing 5G mobile networks. Commercial pilots begin in 2027, with broader deployments starting in 2028.

stories.title: How Much Work Do Robots Really Deliver? The Thinking Behind Worken
stories.summary: AGIBOT introduced Worken, a proposed framework to measure the useful work robots complete by multiplying the number of active robots by their autonomous working hours and an output efficiency ratio. The company stated that Worken is not a universal price for robotic labor but aims to make the contribution of physical AI more measurable through effective intelligent work hours.

stories.title: Did anyone “see or hear small, unmanned aircraft (drones) operating” in the early morning hours? There is an Unmanned Aircraft Systems Exercise in DC the next few nights
stories.summary: Local, state, and federal public safety agencies will conduct a National Capital Region Counter-Unmanned Aircraft Systems exercise on November 10, 11, and 12, with November 13 reserved as a contingency day. Residents may see or hear small, unmanned aircraft operating between 12AM and 4AM during the overnight testing of detection technology.

stories.title: AirSight Metro: Affordable Airspace Intelligence for Cities, Counties, and Towns
stories.summary: AirSight announced the launch of AirSight Metro, an affordable drone detection and airspace intelligence program for cities, counties, and towns.

stories.title: KNDS, German Firm TYTAN Unveil Mobile Drone Defense Vehicle
stories.summary: German defense technology company TYTAN Technologies, in cooperation with defense group KNDS, unveiled its new Drone Defense Vehicle, a mobile counter-unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) system. The vehicle, based on the Dingo 2 Pick-Up armored vehicle, features a rear-mounted platform with autonomous interceptor drones and a rotating sensor mast equipped with radar and electro-optical systems. TYTAN has begun serial production of autonomous interceptor drones, targeting a manufacturing capacity of up to 3,000 units per month. The company offers two AI-powered autonomous interceptor models: EOS, a short-range multirotor, and METIS, a long-range, fixed-wing interceptor that reaches speeds of up to 250 km/h and has an operational range of up to 15 km. The vehicle was unveiled during the inauguration of TYTAN's new facility in Aubing, Munich.

stories.title: Russia is building a new drone base near the border with Ukraine to launch jet-powered drones
stories.summary: Russia is setting up a new launch site for jet-powered drones near Millerovo in the Rostov Region, 50 kilometers from Luhansk. The facility features an 85-meter catapult designed to launch about 100 jet-powered drones per day, supporting plans to increase total drone launch sites from 8 to 20.

stories.title: Otis, Lenovo Partner to Develop Robot for Elevator Installation in Supertall Buildings
stories.summary: Otis and Lenovo announced a partnership to develop a robot that automates drilling inside elevator shafts, with the first deployment planned for China’s Tianjin 117 Tower. The collaboration, revealed at the China International Import Expo in Shanghai, aims to reduce safety risks and improve installation quality by handling repetitive tasks like securing guide rails and installing door hardware.

stories.title: Calogy Solutions qualified as a supplier for the Canadian Defence Drone Initiative
stories.summary: Calogy Solutions, a Sherbrooke QC-based clean technology company, was awarded a procurement agreement under the Government of Canada’s Defence Drone Initiative. The contract, effective from September 10, 2026, to July 31, 2031, qualifies Calogy as a prequalified supplier for future Canadian Armed Forces tenders for drones and autonomous systems.

stories.title: Braiin Advances Defence Sector Strategy as Presenting Partner of the Defence Robotics & Counter-UAS Congress at Global Drone 2026
stories.summary: Braiin Limited announced it is the presenting partner of the Defence Robotics & Counter-UAS Congress at Global Drone 2026, taking place from November 11 to 13, 2026, at Cbus Super Stadium on the Gold Coast, Queensland, Australia. Rob Sutton, Head of Braiin AI and Robotics, will lead sessions on counter-UAS, sovereign robotics capability and critical infrastructure protection, featuring a keynote by Brigadier Grant Chambers, Director General Joint Warfare.

stories.title: Pentagon fields more than 25,000 drones and counter-drone systems with CENTCOM this year
Understanding the ETDL: a new cybersecurity baseline for EU drones
stories.summary: The European trusted drone label (ETDL) support study, presented at the EU Drone Summit on 10 November 2026, proposes a voluntary cybersecurity baseline for drone systems. The study recommends governing the label under the European cybersecurity certification framework, administered by the European Union Agency for Cybersecurity (ENISA) with technical input from the European Union Aviation Safety Agency (EASA).

stories.title: India Hits 280 kmph with Bullet Train 😳
stories.summary: BEML is building B28, India’s first homegrown bullet train, at its Aditya Plant in Bengaluru for the Mumbai-Ahmedabad corridor. The 202-metre, eight-coach train carries 557 passengers and reaches 280 kmph during testing, featuring wheelchair-friendly doors, Braille signage, and regenerative braking.

stories.title: Ondas Receives Purchase Order for Next-Generation Tactical Attack Drones, Aims to Leverage Planned ARAN Defense Acquisition to Manufacture Thousands of Systems
stories.summary: Ondas Inc. received a purchase order under its Digital Bat program for the development and production of next-generation low-cost tactical attack drones. The company plans to use its acquisition of ARAN Defense to establish a dedicated production line capable of manufacturing thousands of systems.

also.title: Ondas (ONDS) Stock: New Drone Contract Advances Mass Production Plans

stories.title: GITEX World RobotiX 2026 brings humanoid debuts and next-gen embodied Artificial Intelligence (AI) to Dubai
stories.summary: GITEX World RobotiX will convene robotics pioneers at Dubai Exhibition Centre from 8-11 December 2026 to showcase embodied AI advances. The event follows a 300 percent year-on-year increase in global humanoid robot shipments, with more than 22,000 units delivered in the first half of 2026.

stories.title: WATCH VIDEO: Advanced Humanoid Robot Performs Remarkably Human-Like Movements, Showcasing How Artificial Intelligence Is Transforming The Future Of Robotics And Automation
stories.summary: A video of a humanoid robot performing smooth, human-like movements has attracted attention online, sparking discussions about the rapid advancement of artificial intelligence and robotics technology.

stories.title: Sudan war: First ‘suicide’ drone attacks, now long-range strikes are the norm
stories.summary: UNICEF reported on Tuesday that long-range drones travelling up to 1,500 kilometres struck at least 15 power stations in Sudan during October, with two in three child casualties this year killed by armed drones. The agency stated that well over 15 million people urgently require shelter, while an estimated 825,000 children under five are expected to suffer from severe acute malnutrition this year.

stories.title: Jeremy Clarkson's Tesla Cybercab Experience Reveals Flaws That Need To Be Addressed
stories.summary: Jeremy Clarkson reported that a Tesla Cybercab in Austin failed to stop at his pickup location, ignored his destination input, and disregarded multiple requests to stop and open doors. A Tesla representative instructed him to cancel the booking and summon a replacement vehicle, which subsequently continued driving past his destination while announcing it needed to find a safe place to pull over.

stories.title: Drone boats that ride almost awash like a drug smuggler's semi-submersible just went to three American
stories.summary: The Defense Innovation Unit awarded three prototype contracts under its Autonomous Low Profile Vessel project to Saronic, Sea Machines Robotics, and Rudder Industries. The goal is crewless cargo boats that can keep Marine units supplied when they’re spread out along coastlines an enemy is fighting over.

stories.title: MP: Railways start fencing 530km track to prevent cattle accidents
stories.summary: The West Central Railway's Bhopal Division is installing fencing along a 530-km stretch between Khandwa and Bina in Madhya Pradesh to prevent cattle from straying onto tracks. Work covering 74km has been completed at a cost of around Rs28.8 million, with the entire project targeted for completion by March 2027.

stories.title: Quantum Cyber Expands and Secures Exclusive Quantum Photonic Array License, Extending Its Quantum Layer Across Air, Surface and Subsea Unmanned Warfare Domains
stories.summary: Quantum Cyber N.V. executed an amendment to its intellectual property license with Project LightShift, expanding exclusive rights to cover unmanned surface vessels, unmanned underwater vehicles, and related maritime systems. The agreement, signed by subsidiary Quantum Drones Corporation, extends the quantum photonic array license beyond unmanned aerial vehicles to include dedicated infrastructure for detection, tracking, and control across air, surface, and subsea domains.

stories.title: AEVEX: Nearly $400 Million U.S. Contract Award To Supply Unmanned Aircraft Systems And Support Services
stories.summary: AEVEX received a multi-year, indefinite-delivery, indefinite-quantity contract with a ceiling of nearly $400 million from an unnamed U.S. customer for unmanned aircraft systems and support services. The agreement allows the customer to issue individual orders as operational requirements develop, with actual revenue depending on the value and timing of those future orders.

also.title: Secretive U.S. drone maker AEVEX lands $400M drone contract

stories.title: Kongsberg, Navantia ink MoU on autonomous underwater vehicles
stories.summary: Kongsberg and Navantia signed a Memorandum of Understanding to integrate HUGIN autonomous underwater vehicles into conventional submarines and develop advanced sonar technologies. The agreement aims to enhance anti-submarine warfare capabilities and ensure compliance with Spanish Navy and NATO operational standards.

stories.title: Ukraine’s fiber-optic drones get squeezed by AI data center demand
Kazakhstan – Uzbekistan freight railway opens to relieve border crossing
stories.summary: Freight trains began using the Darbaza – Maktaaral railway in the Turkistan region, a 286bn tenge project built to provide an alternative route to Uzbekistan and relieve congestion on the main Saryagash – Toshkent corridor.

stories.title: Swiss company Xer Technologies launches X12 hybrid naval drone for naval surveillance and tactical resupply
stories.summary: Swiss manufacturer Xer Technologies AG introduced its updated X12 heavy-duty hybrid-electric naval drone at Euronaval 2026 in Paris. The 70 kg maximum takeoff weight VTOL multicopter combines a 30 kg payload capacity, 7+ hour flight endurance, and a heavy-fuel engine designed for shipboard integration without gasoline fire risks.

stories.title: Skydio launches Controller 2 with a brighter screen and 5G
stories.summary: Skydio began shipping Controller 2, a handheld controller for its X10, X10D, and R10 drones that features a 7-inch, 2,000-nit touchscreen and swappable 5G SIM card support. The device offers approximately 5 hours and 45 minutes of operating time, an IP55 rating, and 128GB of internal storage, with a dedicated Microhard radio version available for X10D operators.

stories.title: European Parliament Committees Propose EU-Wide Rules for Automated Driving Testing and Deployment
stories.summary: The European Parliament’s Environment, Internal Market, and Transport Committees adopted a Joint Committee Report on November 4, 2026, proposing EU-wide rules to harmonize testing and deployment of automated vehicles. The report introduces mutual recognition of national authorizations and an “intermediate type-approval” for commercial pre-deployment, with Parliament’s plenary tentatively scheduled to vote on its negotiating mandate in mid-December 2026.

stories.title: GenRobot AI raises $100 million to expand robot training data infrastructure
stories.summary: GenRobot AI raised $100 million in a Series A+ round completed in the third quarter of 2026, with investors including SAIC Motor, Baidu, and GL Ventures. The Beijing-based company uses hardware and software to capture human movements and process data for training robots in households, factories, and logistics facilities.

stories.title: MiGs for anti-drone systems. An agreement between Poland and Ukraine
stories.summary: Poland agreed to transfer two MiG-29 aircraft to Ukraine in exchange for anti-drone technologies, a deal Minister Cezary Tomczyk described as close to finalization. Poland has also committed to a 50 million euro military donation and has previously transferred 14 MiG-29 jets and over 45 formal donation packages worth approximately 16.5 billion zloty.

also.title: Poland says Ukraine is ready to provide anti-drone technologies in exchange for two MiG-29 fighter jets
Ukraine and Poland sign agreement on working groups for drone technology
Ukraine to Share Counter-Drone Tech With Poland in Exchange for Two MiG-29s
Ukraine and Poland to establish joint working groups on drone and counter-drone technologies

stories.title: Introducing the Waymo Accessibility Network UK: Co-Designing the Future of Autonomous Mobility
stories.summary: Waymo launched the Waymo Accessibility Network UK to inform autonomous mobility in the UK, naming 10 inaugural participants including RNIB and AgeUK. The network will support user research and product testing to refine features like audio cues and vehicle-finding tools for disabled passengers.

stories.title: Electra Defense Receives $4.7 Million US Air Force Contract for EL9 Testing
40% of trains cancelled, over 4,000 passengers affected as Spanish drivers strike after two fatal crashes
stories.summary: Spanish train drivers struck on Tuesday, cancelling 40% of long- and medium-distance services and affecting 4,042 passengers, following two fatal crashes on the Madrid-Seville line this year. The union demanded increased investment in maintenance and safety after talks with the government broke down in April.

stories.title: VisionWave (Nasdaq: VWAV) Adds Six Field-Tested, Commercially Available Unmanned Aerial Systems to Its STRATUM Aerial Portfolio
stories.summary: VisionWave Holdings added six field-tested unmanned aerial systems to its STRATUM portfolio on Nov. 10, 2026, covering surveillance, logistics, and counter-drone operations. The company has not received purchase orders or recognized revenue from these platforms, and their sale remains subject to export-control authorizations.

stories.title: PteroDynamics Targets European Defense Partnerships to Expand Military UAS Opportunities
stories.summary: PteroDynamics Inc. is participating in the 2026 Transatlantic Defense Industry Access Forum, held November 9–12 in Poland and Italy, to explore opportunities for its Transwing unmanned aircraft system in European defense operations. The company is engaging NATO allies and defense industry leaders to evaluate how autonomous vertical takeoff and landing aircraft could support military logistics and resupply missions.

stories.title: Figure AI is hiring a human to babysit humanoid robots overnight
stories.summary: Figure AI is hiring a night-shift coordinator in Santa Clara to oversee its humanoid robots, a contract-to-hire role paying $40 to $45 an hour from 10:30 p.m. to 7 a.m. The position entails scheduling and coaching the team, troubleshooting robot failures and safety issues, and sometimes operating the machines themselves.

stories.title: Michael Healander joins Commercial Drone Alliance board of directors
stories.summary: Michael Healander, Co-Founder, President and CEO of Airspace Link, joined the Commercial Drone Alliance’s board of directors. The alliance stated that Healander brings 25 years of leadership experience working with defence, government agencies, and commercial aviation operators.

stories.title: Matternet and Swisslog Healthcare team up to bring drone delivery to hospitals
stories.summary: Matternet and Swisslog Healthcare’s TransLogic division partnered to connect autonomous drone deliveries with existing automated hospital transport systems. The first year of the partnership will focus on bringing drone delivery to hospital systems in California, Florida, and Arizona using Matternet’s M3 drone delivery platform.

stories.title: WSDOT Opens Public Input on $42bn Cascadia High Speed Rail Project Linking Three Regions
stories.summary: The Washington State Department of Transportation opened public input on a $24 billion to $42 billion high-speed rail project linking Vancouver, B.C., Seattle, and Portland. WSDOT will review the concept until the end of 2028, with estimates suggesting the line could transport 1.3 to 1.7 million passengers.

also.title: WSDOT Seeks Feedback in I-5 High Speed Rail Survey

stories.title: Rheinmetall’s Skyranger to protect Belgian critical infrastructure from drones
stories.summary: The Rheinmetall Group secured a contract to supply 20 Skyranger 30 systems to Belgium for the stationary protection of critical infrastructure from drones. Delivery is scheduled to begin at the end of 2028, and the systems will integrate into the Belgian ‘Blue Dome’ layered air defence programme.

stories.title: SESAR JU and ESA to jointly integrate space tech to support new airspace entrants
stories.summary: The SESAR Joint Undertaking (SESAR JU) and the European Space Agency (ESA) signed a memorandum of cooperation to accelerate the integration of space-enabled technologies into the future Digital European Sky. The parties will assess how European space programmes and infrastructure, including IRIS², Galileo and EGNOS, can strengthen airspace traffic management in Europe.

stories.title: Harmattan AI, Barzan Explore New Counter-Drone Capabilities for Qatar
stories.summary: Harmattan AI and Barzan Holdings signed a memorandum of understanding to explore deploying autonomous very short-range air defense systems in Qatar. The partnership will demonstrate Harmattan AI’s GOBI TEMPEST platform, a mid-range counter-drone interceptor designed for Group 2 and Group 3 aerial threats.

stories.title: Denmark's Lokaltog places first order for Stadler RS Zero railcar
stories.summary: Lokaltog selected Stadler to supply four RS Zero battery railcars for the Jægersborg – Nærum line north of København, marking the first commercial tender selection for the type. The trains are expected to enter service from 2031.

stories.title: New U-space ConOps supports next phase of drone integration in Europe
stories.summary: The SESAR Joint Undertaking’s CORUS Five project published the fifth edition of the U-space Concept of Operations, outlining how drone flights can be organized in busy airspace. The document details three time horizons for integration, notes that initial deployments may require external or public funding, and states that urgent flights should receive priority.

stories.title: Hartford Line service adds New Haven-Hartford trains Nov. 16
stories.summary: The Connecticut Department of Transportation announced that CTrail will add a weekday New Haven-Hartford round trip on November 16, increasing service to 11 northbound and 12 southbound trains. The new northbound train No. 4456 leaves New Haven Union Station at 12:50 p.m., while the return trip No. 4455 departs Hartford at 3 p.m.

stories.title: Ukraine’s drone forces report record 806 Russian troops hit in one day
stories.summary: Ukraine’s Unmanned Systems Forces struck 806 Russian troops, including 295 killed, setting a new all-time daily record on Nov. 10. The units also hit a total of 2,547 Russian targets over 24 hours.

stories.title: Uber’s AV Labs Chief to Leave on Same Day as Its Head of Autonomous
stories.summary: Uber Vice President of Engineering and Science Danny Guo is leaving on November 16, the same day as global head of autonomous mobility and delivery Sarfraz Maredia. Guo, who reports to Chief Technology Officer Praveen Neppalli Naga, is taking a role outside the transportation industry. His departure occurs weeks before Uber plans to begin fully driverless testing of its robotaxi with Lucid and Nuro.

also.title: Another Uber executive, Danny Guo, to depart

stories.title: Volz Servos contribute to Singapore’s first indigenous eVTOL
stories.summary: Researchers at Nanyang Technological University (NTU) flew the first eVTOL aircraft completely designed, engineered, and built in Singapore. The 8-meter wingspan demonstrator, equipped with Volz Servos actuators, reached heights above 90 meters during a month-long test campaign in Summer 2026 at the DLR National Experimental Test Center for Unmanned Aircraft Systems in Germany.

stories.title: Valkyrie Dynamics Raises €1M for All-Weather Drone Radar
stories.summary: Valkyrie Dynamics raised €1M in a pre-seed round led by Hexa to develop a 100-gram radar seeker for low-cost drones. The company plans to use the funds for manufacturing, next-generation development, and team expansion, with European technical integration hubs planned for late 2026.

also.title: From sleeping on a Kyiv factory floor to €1M funding: Valkyrie Dynamics takes on drone warfare
Valkyrie Dynamics raises €1M for a miniature radar seeker that lets interceptor drones hunt in any weather

stories.title: Why Is the Robot as a Service (RaaS) Market Becoming a High-Growth Investment Opportunity Amid Rising Demand f
stories.summary: DataM Intelligence valued the global Robot as a Service market at USD 2.60 billion in 2025, projecting it will reach USD 12.84 billion by 2035. The report attributes this 18% compound annual growth rate to rising demand for flexible automation and reduced upfront capital expenditure.

stories.title: Russian Drones Hit Ukraine's Power Grid and Black Sea Ships
stories.summary: Russian forces struck four Ukrainian electrical substations and three Black Sea vessels overnight, targeting energy facilities that supplied defense industry enterprises and ships transporting military supplies. Ukrainian First Deputy Prime Minister Denis Shmygal stated that Russian tactics have shifted toward coordinated operations using AI-enabled jet-powered drones and MESH networking technology to improve strike accuracy and communication.

stories.title: Russian governor confirms industrial site damaged in Novgorod drone attack
stories.summary: The Novgorod regional governor confirmed that a drone attack overnight on Nov. 10 damaged an industrial site and two vacation homes, with no casualties reported. Ukrainian monitoring channels reported explosions near the 123rd Aircraft Repair Plant in Staraya Russa, a facility that services Russian military transport aircraft, though independent confirmation of damage to the plant remains lacking.

stories.title: Amazon takes major step towards UK expansion of drone delivery service
stories.summary: Amazon secured the world’s first Sail 4 operating authorisation from the Civil Aviation Authority, enabling Prime Air drone deliveries to around 8,000 households in the Darlington area starting Tuesday. This expansion allows drones to fly across urban areas, increasing access from the previous 600 pilot customers.

also.title: UK aviation regulator clears Amazon for expanded drone delivery
Amazon secures UK approval to expand drone deliveries
Amazon Secures UK Regulatory Clearance for Drone Trials
Amazon SAILs forth with massive drone expansion
Mayor welcomes expansion of Amazon drone deliveries
Amazon makes aviation history with world’s first SAIL 4 drone approval
Amazon’s Prime Air secures the world’s first SAIL 4 approval from the UK Civil Aviation Authority
UK Regulator Clears Amazon Drone Delivery Expansion in Darlington

stories.title: World Bank: Robotics Adoption Mitigates GDP Losses from Labor Shortages in Advanced Economies
stories.summary: The World Bank published a September 2026 study indicating that robotics adoption mitigates GDP losses from labor shortages in advanced economies. The analysis projects that doubling robot productivity by 2035 would narrow China's projected GDP loss from 5.6% to 4.9%, while reducing the aggregate GDP loss across 46 developed nations from 2.3% to 1.9%.

stories.title: U.S. special forces want a helmet display with drone control
Ukrainian Drones Strike Russia’s TOS-1A Thermobaric Rocket Launcher in Donetsk Region
stories.summary: Ukrainian drone operators from the 4th Battalion of the 413th Raid Regiment struck a Russian TOS-1A Solntsepyok thermobaric rocket launcher concealed in a shelter in the Russian-occupied Donetsk region. The targeted system reportedly belonged to a radiation, chemical, and biological defense company attached to Russia’s 76th Guards Air Assault Division.

stories.title: Fact Check: Viral post featuring Taiwan’s bullet train falsely shared as an Indian train
stories.summary: Fact-checkers determined that viral images and videos of the N700ST high-speed train are from Taiwan, not India. The footage shows the first of 12 new N700ST trainsets ordered from Japan being unloaded at the Port of Kaohsiung, contradicting claims that the images depict India's Mumbai-Ahmedabad High-Speed Rail Corridor.

stories.title: Drones attacked the occupied cities of Donetsk and Luhansk, Berdyansk, and regions of Russia; there are widespread power outages
stories.summary: On the night of November 10, drones attacked the temporarily occupied territories of Ukraine and a number of regions in Russia. The strikes caused widespread power outages in Donetsk and Luhansk.

stories.title: Machina to develop metal airframe for LUCAS-class uncrewed aircraft
Moskva aims for 90% of its tram fleet to be driverless by 2035
stories.summary: Moskva plans to expand driverless tram operations to two additional routes by the end of this year, targeting 90% of its fleet to be equipped with the technology by 2035.

also.title: Moskva to Expand Driverless Tram Service to Two More Routes by End of 2026

stories.title: ASEAN in the global robotics value chain and prospects for Vietnam-Malaysia cooperation.
stories.summary: Samirul Ariff Othman, a policy analyst at Global Asia Consulting, advised that Malaysia and Vietnam should initiate substantive commercial cooperation to build a high-value robotics ecosystem. He proposed four pillars, including business-led research, product development, workforce training, and a network linking bilateral testing facilities, to help the region retain a greater share of added value from the smart technology revolution.

stories.title: VESSEL REVIEW | Vanta 12 – German-designed modular USV for strike and reconnaissance
stories.summary: Berlin-based Stark Defence unveiled its Vanta 12 unmanned surface vehicle on September 28, 2026, designed to carry MBDA's Sea Venom anti-ship missile and Cascade loitering munition. The 12-metre craft, which participated in NATO REPMUS 2026 exercises, is slated for production in the hundreds per year under agreements with Danish and German shipyards.

stories.title: US Marines Seek New Extended-Range Cargo Drones

also.title: U.S. Marines Train with Neros Archer FPV Attack Drones to Extend Infantry Strike Range

stories.title: MARINA holds forum on seafarer training for AI, autonomous ships
stories.summary: The Maritime Industry Authority (MARINA) is examining whether simulator-based training can partially replace seagoing service and what skills Filipino seafarers need to operate maritime autonomous surface ships (MASS). These topics were among four studies presented at a MARINA research forum on Monday, Nov. 9, 2026.

stories.title: LMT Defence, Thales join forces to advance counter-drone technologies in Europe
stories.summary: LMT Defence and Thales Italia signed a Memorandum of Understanding to explore drone detection using mobile network infrastructure and defense 4G/5G technologies. The agreement allows the companies to evaluate combining LMT products with Thales Italia’s solutions to track drones via behavioral patterns, with the potential to progress towards a proof of concept subject to mutual agreement.

stories.title: ‘Fundamentally different’: NATO tests 400-drone battlefield as military threats intensify
stories.summary: NATO conducted a two-week exercise in Latvia involving more than 30 countries and 100 industrial partners, culminating in a scenario with almost 400 drones. Simultaneously, the Royal Navy launched Nyan Maritime attack drones from HMS Queen Elizabeth, marking the first time strike drones took off from a British carrier.

stories.title: Foreign Tier 1 Suppliers Begin "Selling Scenarios" to Robotics Companies
stories.summary: Aptiv signed cooperation agreements with Tars and Shanghai Electric at the China International Import Expo. Tars revealed plans to deploy hundreds of A-series robots by the end of 2026, covering eight major production processes and 33 application scenarios.

stories.title: After US restrictions pushed it to launch in Rwanda, Zipline raises $1.5 billion at a $21.5 billion valuation as Uber and Walmart take its Africa-tested drones nationwide
Bullet Train Project: Overhead Wires on Surat–Bilimora Section to Be Energised from November 20
stories.summary: The National High Speed Rail Corporation Limited announced that overhead electrical wires on the Surat–Bilimora section of the Mumbai–Ahmedabad High Speed Rail Project will be energised on or after November 20, 2026. The corporation warned the public to treat all overhead wires as live from that date and cautioned against approaching the installations to prevent accidents.

stories.title: ADF down 135 of 162 Russian drones launched against Ukraine overnight
stories.summary: Ukraine’s air defense forces neutralized 135 of 162 Russian drones launched against Ukraine since the evening of November 9. The attack included one Iskander-M ballistic missile and 162 Shahed-type attack drones, with hits recorded at 19 locations and four people injured in Kharkiv.

stories.title: Cowin Robotics wins robot system order from global ESS company
stories.summary: Cowin Robotics won a new order for a robot integration system from an unnamed global energy storage system company on Nov. 10. The system will be deployed at the customer’s mid- to large-sized ESS manufacturing line, expanding robot use to battery pack manufacturing and inspection processes.

stories.title: Robotic Car Charger Locks On With Suction
stories.summary: Mew463 built a low-profile robotic car charger that uses two suction cups to anchor itself to the vehicle while a gear assembly pushes the charger home. The robot uses API calls to remotely unlock the charge port and relies on four Mecanum wheels, LiDAR, and an onboard camera with a ChARuco board pattern for precise alignment.

stories.title: SNCF Voyageurs signs Île-de-France commuter train operating contract
stories.summary: Île-de-France Mobilités signed a directly awarded contract for SNCF Voyageurs to operate Transilien suburban services in 2026-30. The agreement includes higher requirements for several performance indicators.

stories.title: Gumi City Visits China's Humanoid Industry Site...Looking to enter the robot manufacturing supply chain
stories.summary: Gumi City Mayor Kim Jang-ho led a delegation to Beijing and Shanghai from the 9th to the 12th to examine humanoid robot mass production and certification systems. The city aims to connect local electronics and semiconductor capabilities to the global robot supply chain, focusing on core parts development and mass production methods.

also.title: Gumi Officials Tour China's Robot Hubs to Expand Manufacturing Into Humanoids
Gumi sends delegation to China to benchmark humanoid robot production

stories.title: Epson AX6 collaborative robot weighs just 17 kg and works right next to human factory crews
stories.summary: Epson launched the AX6 collaborative robot in Southeast Asia, featuring a 17 kg body and ISO Class 5 cleanroom classification. The unit operates on AC and DC power, includes hand-guided teaching, and allows human workers to share the workspace safely.

stories.title: Russian Drone Attacks Threaten Ukraine Rail Travel
stories.summary: Human Rights Watch reported that Russian drone attacks on Ukrainian trains killed and injured civilians, including railway workers, and threatened a transportation system millions depend on. Oleksandr Shevchenko, deputy head of passenger services at Ukrzaliznytsia, stated that Russian forces damaged or destroyed more than 500 locomotives since 2022, including more than 300 in 2026 alone.

stories.title: Wing makes a $125 million bet on U.S. drone manufacturing
stories.summary: Alphabet-owned Wing announced a $125 million investment over the next two years to build a 15,000-square-foot manufacturing facility in Fort Worth, Texas, capable of producing tens of thousands of aircraft annually and creating up to 100 jobs.

also.title: Wing to invest $125M in drone manufacturing plant
Alphabet’s Wing Flies Into Fort Worth With Drone Factory

stories.title: CDG autonomous vehicle stops in yellow box in Punggol, company adjusting software after incident
stories.summary: ComfortDelGro is adjusting the software of one of its autonomous vehicles after it stopped within a yellow box on Northshore Drive in Punggol. The company stated that its onboard safety operator flagged the matter and is improving the vehicle's handling of junctions to comply with traffic rules.

stories.title: Nvidia Details South Korean Projects for Factories, Robots and Self-Driving
stories.summary: Nvidia announced partnerships with Samsung Electronics, SK hynix, Hyundai Motor Group, LG Electronics, and Kakao Mobility for physical AI projects in South Korea. The initiatives include digital twins for semiconductor factories, robot training simulations, and a Level 4 autonomous-driving system for Kia PBV vehicles.

stories.title: Army small drone crashes in Gimpo during training; probe to focus on comms loss
stories.summary: An Army small unmanned aerial vehicle crashed near a training site in Gimpo, Gyeonggi, after losing communications. Army spokesperson Bae Seok-jin stated the unit retrieved the damaged airframe after a resident reported it, and the Army is investigating why communications were lost and how the aircraft left the training area.

also.title: (LEAD) Military drone crashes in Gimpo; no civilian damage reported: Army
A military drone that was training at Gimpo Park crashed...No casualties

stories.title: Turkey Shows Ukraine TOLGA Anti-Drone Defense System
stories.summary: Ukrainian officials led by Pavel Palisa visited a Turkish testing ground where MKE demonstrated the TOLGA anti-drone system, which features 20mm cannons capable of firing 3,200 rounds per minute. MKE indicated readiness to supply the system to Kiev, though no contract has been announced.

stories.title: Good news for passengers as Indian Railways set to run special train between Lucknow and Mumbai; check stoppages and fares
stories.summary: Indian Railways will operate a one-way reserved festival special train from Lucknow to Lokmanya Tilak Terminus (Mumbai) on Tuesday, departing at 9:45 pm and arriving at 3:35 am the following day. The train, numbered 04258, will include 20 coaches across AC, sleeper, and general categories to address rising passenger rush during the festive season.

stories.title: North Dakota Advanced Air Mobility and Drone Survey Tallies 27 Entities, About $159.5 Million in Committed Funding
stories.summary: A survey updated November 8, 2026, lists 27 North Dakota advanced air mobility entities with about $159.5 million in committed funding. The update adds Project RuralReach, a federally funded University of North Dakota drone trial that included a medical delivery flight from Williston to Watford City on July 24, 2025.

stories.title: Humble Hauler autonomous trailer takes the truck out of trucking [update]
stories.summary: Humble Robotics secured more than $75 million after a $51 million Series A funding round led by Obvious Ventures. The company will use the capital for customer pilots, testing, and early manufacturing of its driverless, cab-less battery-electric freight platform.

also.title: Autonomous EV developer Humble Robotics adds $51M to expand
Humble Robotics raises $51 million for autonomous cargo platform — Electrek

stories.title: China's GJ-11 Stealth Drone Lost Its Target in Cloud, Then Hit It
stories.summary: China’s state broadcaster CCTV aired new footage of the GJ-11 stealth combat drone on Monday, showing its internal weapon bays and confirming it hit a target in its first live-fire test after thick cloud obscured the initial pass. The report, part of a countdown to the 77th anniversary of the People’s Liberation Army Air Force, did not specify when the test occurred or which weapon was fired.

also.title: [VIDEO] China Reports First GJ-11 Stealth Drone Strike, Raising Stakes for Taiwan
China reveals new details of GJ-11 stealth combat drone in official footage
China’s GJ-11 stealth drone gets rare close-up as new footage reveals weapons bay

stories.title: Nagoya Station for Maglev Line to Be Completed in 2033 or Later
stories.summary: Central Japan Railway Co. officials said the new Nagoya Station for the maglev line is expected to be completed in 2033 or later. The company plans to announce a new opening schedule within this year after giving up its original 2027 target.

also.title: Maglev construction at Nagoya Station won’t be completed until at least 2033

stories.title: Tesla Robotaxi Cybercab Near Disney World Nov 9, No Park Access
stories.summary: Attractions Magazine staff photographed a gold two-seat Tesla Cybercab testing near Walt Disney World Resort on Interstate 4 on November 9, 2026. Tesla has not confirmed passenger service in the area, and its current limited Robotaxi service in Orlando excludes the theme parks and airport.

stories.title: LG Electronics tests CLOiD robot at washing machine factory using Nvidia AI
stories.summary: LG Electronics presented its CLOiD robot training process at Nvidia AI Day Seoul 2026, demonstrating how it uses Nvidia's GR00T model to hang 4-kg washing machine top panels. The company raised its robot training data target from 100,000 hours to 500,000 hours.

stories.title: Shield AI Bets $5.3B on Echodyne's Drone Radar at a $28.8B Valuation
stories.summary: Shield AI agreed to buy Echodyne for up to $5.3 billion, paying $4.8 billion at closing and up to $500 million more if performance targets are met. The San Diego company announced the deal on November 5, with closing expected in early 2027 once regulators sign off.

also.title: Five Federal Departments Sign Deal to Fast-Track Counter-Drone Shield Systems
US agencies form ‘whole-of-government’ pact to counter drone threats

stories.title: Community leaders say new environmental study of Amtrak’s proposed South Side facility ‘woefully inadequate’
stories.summary: The Federal Railroad Administration released a 59-page environmental assessment of Amtrak’s proposed $915 million maintenance facility near Rate Field, a move Ald. Nicole Lee and Cook County Commissioner John Daley called “woefully insufficient.” The agency opened a 30-day public comment period ending December 7, while Amtrak scheduled two public meetings in early December to discuss the document.

stories.title: Bulgaria Reports Discovery of Human Remains on Ship Hit by Drone
stories.summary: Bulgarian officials confirmed the discovery of severely damaged human remains aboard the Wine Trader, a tanker struck by drones off Romania's coast on October 15. The Varna District Prosecutor’s Office ordered DNA testing to identify the deceased, while Bulgarian media reported that six of the seven missing seafarers were likely located on the vessel.

stories.title: China's EHang unveils EH216-EK firefighting eVTOL
stories.summary: EHang unveiled the EH216-EK firefighting eVTOL at its Wencheng Smart Manufacturing Center, featuring a 12-channel release system for 10-kilogram or 20-kilogram extinguishing canisters. The aircraft, with a 620-kilogram maximum takeoff weight, completed an on-site demonstration flight to showcase precision suppression capabilities for early-stage fires.

stories.title: Axon Pours $1.2 Billion Into San Mateo Drone Maker Skydio, Locks Up Exclusive Deal
stories.summary: Axon announced Thursday it is investing an additional $1.2 billion in Skydio, valuing the San Mateo drone maker at $5.2 billion pre-money. The deal makes Axon the exclusive distributor of Skydio products to public safety agencies in the United States and Canada, with transactions expected to close in stages across the fourth quarter of 2026 and the first quarter of 2027.

stories.title: Group walking 100 kilometres to Ottawa raising concerns over Alto high-speed rail project
stories.summary: A group is walking 100 kilometres to Ottawa to raise concerns over the Alto high-speed rail project.

stories.title: Russia Threatens Japanese Drone Manufacturer Terra Drone with Attacks
stories.summary: Russian Foreign Ministry spokeswoman Maria Zakharova threatened to attack Terra Drone's Ukrainian production facilities on October 21, following the company's October 14 announcement that its subsidiary Kulin delivered interceptor drones to the Ukrainian Ministry of Defense. Terra Drone CEO Toru Tokushige stated the company produces more than 12,000 interceptor drones annually and proposed mandatory requirements for domestic value creation in government procurement.

stories.title: AI Agents Generate and Refine Robot Control Programs
stories.summary: Ken Goldberg presented “agentic robotics” at the Conference on Robot Learning, a method where AI agents generate, test, and refine robot control programs in simulation. His team is releasing open-source code built on NVIDIA’s Isaac open simulation framework and an industry-standard benchmark for evaluating robot performance.

In First, Two CCAs Fly Air Combat Maneuvers Using Autonomy Software
stories.summary: Shield AI announced Nov. 9 that two FQ-44A drones flew air combat maneuvers coordinated by Hivemind autonomy software in a test Oct. 26 at the Nevada Test and Training Range. Shield AI vice president Todd Wesley said the test was a success and the company plans to add more assets and complexity to future exercises.

Two US Air Force combat drones complete first coordinated flight using new software

stories.title: Ukrainian Tech Team Develops Pocket Weather Station to Help Turrets Hit FPV Drones
stories.summary: Ukrainian engineers developed Strilets Core, a 234-gram portable weather station with an offline ballistic computer to help turrets intercept FPV drones. The device passed laboratory testing at Dnipro Technical College of Radio Electronics and is now seeking investment for production-ready field testing.

stories.title: An underwater combat drone weighing more than 11 tons and over 30 feet long was just put under contract for the French Navy, designed to fly in on a cargo plane, slip off a pier or a warship and run long missions on its own under human supervision, and onl
stories.summary: The French defense ministry’s innovation agency (AID) signed a contract with Naval Group to build an operational demonstrator of its Unmanned Combat Underwater Vehicle, or UCUV, for the French Navy. The agency announced the deal the next day. It says the drone has to be air-transportable, has to go into the water from a quay or a surface ship, and has to make a lot of its own decisions once it’s down there.

stories.title: Autonomous-driving pilot vehicles to reach 3,000 next year... Europe urges unified rules, saying “business viability is key”
stories.summary: The government plans to increase autonomous-driving pilot vehicles to at least 3,000 next year and revise Level 4 safety standards. European automakers urged Korea to adopt UN international standards, stating that differing regulations from country to country are hampering wider adoption.

stories.title: First ever autonomous Royal Navy squadron launches as part of investment in hybrid operations
stories.summary: The Royal Navy commissioned its first autonomous squadron on November 5 at His Majesty’s Naval Base Portsmouth, operating uncrewed surface vessels like the Kraken and Rattler. The 180-personnel unit replaces Project Beehive and operates under a £1.5bn four-year investment in hybrid operations.

stories.title: NVIDIA launches GR00T 2 and Isaac Lab 3.0 at CoRL
stories.summary: NVIDIA introduced GR00T 2 and Isaac Lab 3.0 at the Conference on Robot Learning in Austin, Texas. The company announced an investment in South Korean startup Point2 and revealed that partners like Foxconn and Siemens are testing the new technologies for factory automation and industrial use cases.

stories.title: WMATA Plans December Rail Work, Single Tracking on Three Lines
stories.summary: The Washington Metropolitan Area Transit Authority (WMATA) will conduct rail work from Dec. 18–30, with service changes planned on the Green, Orange, Silver and Blue lines. Green Line trains will single-track between U Street and Georgia Avenue-Petworth from Dec. 18-30, while Orange and Silver line trains will single-track between McPherson Square and Smithsonian from Dec. 20-30.

stories.title: Archer Aviation CEO sets year-end target for piloted transition flight
stories.summary: Archer Aviation CEO Adam Goldstein set a year-end deadline for the company's piloted transition flight, a prerequisite for FAA certification and its 2027 commercial launch. Speaking on the 2026 Q3 earnings call, Goldstein described the program as being in "the final push," noting the aircraft is flying faster with each successive flight.

stories.title: Archer Aviation: Boeing set to become largest shareholder in $3.8B eVTOL bet
stories.summary: Archer Aviation CEO Adam Goldstein stated that Boeing will become the largest shareholder in a $3.8 billion company after the pending deal closes, with only one of nearly 20 approvals remaining. Archer's first aircraft is now stationed in Los Angeles, and the FAA airworthiness certificate clears piloted Midnight operations within weeks.

stories.title: YYForce’s Humanoid Robotics and VLA Training Workflow Featured on Mediacorp’s Meeting AI
stories.summary: Mediacorp aired a feature on November 6, 2026, showcasing YYForce's humanoid robotics training workflow. The broadcast demonstrated the Unitree G1 robot learning to grasp and move a cup after 40 human demonstrations and eight hours of Vision-Language-Action model training.

stories.title: New Footage Shows China’s First Unmanned Stealth Fighters in Frontline Service
stories.summary: Newly released footage of China’s GJ-11 Sharp Sword unmanned stealth fighters has offered a rare look at the aircraft’s internal weapon bays. The Chinese People’s Liberation Army Air Force confirmed its first known deployment of GJ-11 at Shigatse Air Base in Tibet in October 2025.

stories.title: NHTSA opens recall query into 2,895 Waymo robotaxis that kept passing stopped school buses after a software fix
stories.summary: The National Highway Traffic Safety Administration opened a recall query on Nov. 6 covering 2,895 Waymo robotaxis to determine if a software fix adequately prevented vehicles from passing stopped school buses. The agency found a majority of identified incidents occurred after Waymo completed the over-the-air remedy on Nov. 17, 2025.

also.title: Waymo Robotaxis Just Keep Passing School Buses After Software Fix, According to Feds

stories.title: How autonomous vehicles are changing oilsands mining
stories.summary: Autonomous vehicles are increasingly present in many oilsands operations, impacting safety, productivity and jobs.

stories.title: Robotic Additive Manufacturing Uses Continuous Beech Veneer to Reinforce
stories.summary: Architectural researchers demonstrated a robotic additive manufacturing process that deposits continuous beech veneer along calculated principal stress lines to structurally reinforce lightweight timber slabs. The team used an ABB IRB4600 robotic arm to apply reactive polyurethane hot-melt adhesives, achieving a 433 percent relative improvement in joint tightness compared to manual fabrication.

stories.title: FAA Grants First Authorization for BVLOS Drone Operations Over Gulf
stories.summary: The FAA issued the first authorization for a drone to fly beyond the operator’s visual line of sight over the Gulf on November 9, 2026. Skyways will fly its autonomous V2 aircraft from a Shell facility in Gibson, La., to an offshore platform to conduct a pipeline inspection and simulated equipment delivery.

stories.title: Musk says many Cybertruck buyers will get deposits back as production ends, arguing ‘opportunity cost’ is vastly outweighed by new robotaxi
stories.summary: Elon Musk said Monday that Tesla will return deposits to many Cybertruck buyers because orders far exceed production rates, following his Friday announcement that the company is winding down the vehicle's production by the middle of next year.

stories.title: Ukrainian forces strike elite Russian 'Rubicon' drone unit in occupied territory
stories.summary: Ukraine's Southern Defense Forces announced on Nov. 9 that a joint operation struck a Russian "Rubicon" drone unit base in the occupied city of Berdyansk, Zaporizhzhia Oblast. The attack, which occurred on Nov. 7, targeted a temporary deployment point and drone control point located 107 kilometers behind the front lines.

stories.title: Russia's Geran-5 K5-K Drone Rivals Cruise Missiles: GUR
stories.summary: Ukraine's Main Intelligence Directorate (GUR) reports that Russian forces began actively deploying upgraded Geran-5 K5-K jet-powered kamikaze drones this autumn. The GUR states the drones have speeds up to 1,000 km/h, a range of 1,000 km, and can carry a warhead weighing up to 90 kilograms.
