stories.title: Mujin Opens M1 Experience Center in Georgia to Showcase AI-Powered Robotic Automation
stories.summary: Mujin Corp. opened its M1 Experience Center in Suwanee, Georgia, on November 5, 2026, to provide manufacturers and warehouse operators with live demonstrations of AI-powered robotic automation. The facility features palletizing, depalletizing, and picking applications powered by MujinOS, allowing visitors to evaluate systems and participate in training programs before committing to deployment.

stories.title: From TractEasy to TLD Robotics: A new chapter in autonomous airport operations
stories.summary: TLD Robotics formally launched in September 2026 following ALVEST Group’s acquisition of EasyMile, consolidating EasyMile, TractEasy, and TLD’s existing driverless vehicle activities. The new company combines autonomous driving technology, vehicle manufacturing, and operational expertise, having completed more than 50,000 autonomous missions across more than 35 sites in 10 countries.

stories.title: Contract Clauses Shield Drone Operators in Plant Inspections
stories.summary: UAV operators and corporate clients are shifting operational risk into Master Service Agreements to mitigate exposures that frequently exceed the total value of inspection contracts. These agreements include waivers of consequential damages, aggregate liability caps, and knock-for-knock indemnities to protect operators from ruinous liability during high-risk infrastructure inspections.

stories.title: Drone Kills Zaporizhzhia Nuclear Plant Worker, Second in Under Two Weeks
stories.summary: A drone strike killed a worker at the Russian-occupied Zaporizhzhia Nuclear Power Plant on November 9, the second plant employee killed in a drone attack in less than two weeks, the International Atomic Energy Agency said. In a separate incident the same day, a worker at the nearby Zaporizhzhia Thermal Power Plant was also killed.

stories.title: Public safety agencies will fly drones over the region after midnight for three nights
stories.summary: Local, state and federal agencies will fly drones across the Washington region between midnight and 4 a.m. on Tuesday, Wednesday and Thursday to test technology meant to detect and track unauthorized aircraft, the Metropolitan Washington Council of Governments said Monday.

President Speaks at Kennedy Space Center on Artemis, Supersonic Flight and Planned Annual Cape Canaveral Aerospace Event
stories.summary: The President spoke at NASA's Kennedy Space Center on Nov. 6, 2026, addressing U.S. aerospace leadership, the Artemis program, and commercial supersonic flight. The Department of Transportation announced a proposed noise-based certification rule on June 30, 2026, and the FAA aims to finalize both planned supersonic rules by mid-2027.

stories.title: Boom Supersonic Completes First Supersonic Turbine Core for Superpower, Begins Testing in Colorado
stories.summary: Boom Supersonic completed the first supersonic turbine core for its Superpower solution and began testing at its facility in Watkins, Colorado. The 42-megawatt natural gas turbine, designed for AI data centers, will help fund the Overture airliner program, which has a reported $1.25 billion backlog of orders.

stories.title: SELF-DRIVING Trucks Are HERE: Venti CEO Reveals US Fleet Operations
stories.summary: Venti Technologies is operating approximately 60 fully autonomous container trucks 24/7 in intermodal yards across California and Texas. The company, which describes its software system as costing roughly $70 million to $80 million, has agreements with several Class I railroads and expects significant rail-yard volume to materialize in two years.

stories.title: Kakao Mobility Bets on Nvidia’s Most Powerful Chips to Win Korea’s Robotaxi Race
stories.summary: Kakao Mobility locked in Nvidia hardware to power its next generation of fully autonomous robotaxis, shifting from cautious testing into a credible race for Level 4 certification. The agreement, formalized at Nvidia AI Day Seoul 2026, pairs dual Nvidia Drive AGX Thor processors with Kakao's proprietary end-to-end AI model and Kia purpose-built vehicles. Seoul has set a target of launching fully unmanned Level 4 robotaxis in its Sangam autonomous driving district starting October 2026.

stories.title: USA expand counter-drone cooperation
stories.summary: Five federal departments announced an agreement to coordinate the testing and deployment of counter-drone systems while protecting civilian aircraft and navigation equipment. The memorandum of understanding, led by the White House Task Force to Restore American Airspace Sovereignty, covers cooperation on technical requirements, field testing and information sharing.

stories.title: Boston Dynamics adds wheels to Atlas humanoid to test whole-body control
stories.summary: Boston Dynamics released a video showing its Atlas humanoid using wheels to test whole-body control. The company stated the wheeled Atlas is a research testbed, not a product, and Andy Wu, controls engineer for Atlas, attached off-the-shelf scooter rims to the robot's ankles to push actuation limits.

stories.title: Federal Agreement Could Cut Counter-Drone Reviews to 24 Hours
stories.summary: Five federal departments announced a new agreement on November 9 to speed the evaluation and deployment of counter-drone technology while protecting civilian aviation. According to Reuters, FAA official Liam McKenna said the agency has approved more than 1,000 counter-drone coordination requests involving the Pentagon and DHS.

stories.summary: Kongsberg Maritime unveiled the Arctic Hunter, a fully uncrewed surface vessel based on an 184-foot fishing hull, to meet the Royal Navy’s Type 92 requirement for persistent anti-submarine warfare in the High North. The design, announced November 9, integrates Thales Sonar 2087 and aims for 60 days of autonomous operation to expand the fleet’s sensing capacity.

stories.summary: Tesla activated its fully driverless Robotaxi service in San Antonio at 5 a.m. local time Monday, making the city its eighth market nationwide and fifth in Texas. The launch geofence covers approximately 275 square miles, the company's biggest opening map to date, and San Antonio now hosts two fully driverless, commercially active robotaxi services simultaneously, a first for any U.S. market.

Finland and Patria Demonstrate Autonomous Air and Sea Systems
stories.summary: The Finnish Navy announced the formation of an unmanned systems company within its Coastal Brigade starting early next year, following a demonstration of Patria's autonomous air and sea systems in Upinniemi on November 5.

stories.title: HMS Queen Elizabeth launches UK-made strike drones in first-ever trial
stories.summary: The Royal Navy launched four Nyan One-Way Effector drones from HMS Queen Elizabeth in the North Atlantic during Exercise Neptune Reach B, with each striking its assigned target. The trials support Project Vantage and the Defence One-Way Effector programme, contributing to the Navy’s development of a hybrid carrier air wing.

stories.title: Ground Robot Uses Hyperspectral Imaging to Spot Multiple Seed Potato
stories.summary: Agricultural engineers and plant pathologists in the Netherlands evaluated an autonomous field robotics framework that pairs visible to short-wave infrared hyperspectral imaging with machine learning to identify diseased seed potato canopies. The investigation targeted the simultaneous in-field detection of three major potato pathogens: Potato virus Y, Potato leafroll virus, and bacterial blackleg caused by Pectobacterium and Dickeya species.

stories.title: Astrion and Pierce Aerospace Partner to Advance Counter-UAS Capabilities for Homeland Security and Defense Missions
stories.summary: Astrion and Pierce Aerospace announced a strategic partnership to integrate Remote ID technology with mission engineering for counter-unmanned aircraft systems capabilities. The collaboration coincides with the Federal Emergency Management Agency making an additional $250 million available through its fiscal year 2027 Counter-UAS Grant Program, which extends funding to all 56 states and territories.

stories.title: FEMA Urges State and Local Agencies to Act on Counter-Drone Readiness
stories.summary: FEMA Administrator Cameron Hamilton urged state and local agencies to strengthen counter-drone capabilities during a November 9 forum in Maryland. He highlighted a $500 million federal commitment to counter-UAS technology and advised agencies to assess readiness, utilize available grants, and improve communication to address emerging threats.

stories.title: The Trump administration pledges to accelerate the deployment of counter-drone systems, and the Pentagon reinforces its forces in the Middle East
stories.summary: The Trump administration pledged to accelerate the deployment of advanced counter-drone systems, and the Pentagon announced the completion of a “massive” delivery of more than 1,300 attack drones, over 100 unmanned aerial vehicles, and more than 24,000 counter-drone systems to U.S. forces in the Middle East.

stories.title: Honda launches $10,000 challenge to improve human-robot collaboration in factories
stories.summary: Honda partnered with Base 11 and Freelancer to launch a $10,000 competition for young Americans to develop ideas for safer human-robot collaboration in manufacturing. The challenge, announced on October 27, invited US residents aged 18 to 26 to propose ways robotics could address workplace hazards or physically demanding tasks.
